Method of Attack: Backdoor targeting Microsoft Exchange mail servers
Persistence via Exchange Server Transport Agent
Remote control via specially crafted JPG or PDF email attachments using steganography
Intercept emails, exfiltrate data, send mails on behalf of victims
Commands encoded in email attachments using steganography
Blocks emails containing commands upon detection
Discoverer: Kaspersky Lab’s Global Research and Analysis Team (GReAT)
Attack Vector: Email attachments with steganographically encoded commands
Indicators of Compromise: Extensive list of IoCs and malware samples provided by ESET on GitHub
